// A plane curve expressed in polar form about the origin: the position at angle
// theta is (RadiusAt(theta) * cos(theta), RadiusAt(theta) * sin(theta)).
// The canonical [0,1] parameter maps to one full turn unless documented otherwise
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polar_coordinate_system).
interface IPolarCurve2D
    inherits ICurve2D
{
    RadiusAt(x: Self, angle: Angle): Number;
}
